notes: Transient mode finds the tempo you would count: a half-time groove at 138 BPM shows 138, not 69, and drum & bass, trap, dubstep, hip-hop and ballads come out right too.
Bars and sections stay in time from the first bar to the last: a fixed beat grid like a DJ player's, and one that follows the band for songs played without a click.
New "Auto-detect transient" switch, off whenever you open a song: off, every section sits exactly on the beat grid; on, cuts land on each beat's attack and Auto is available.
Every division on one row, from 32 bars down to 1/64, with sensitivity, Loop and the new switch above it; a new song opens on 1:1.
The bar 1 flag starts at the beginning of the audio and only moves when you drag it; cuts after a build-up land right where the drop comes in.
Chrome extension setup: opens the extensions page in a new tab of the Chrome you already have open, instead of an empty new window.
The extension folder's path is shown in the setup window with a copy button, and the window stays in sight while you work in Chrome.
Installing Cachalot now offers to set up the Chrome extension: it copies the extension, opens Chrome and checks off each step as you go, and the extension pairs itself.
The Chrome extension now updates itself whenever Cachalot updates.
New transient mode in the extension: turns a song into its waveform, sliced on the beats and bars it detects, with loop preview, fades, undo and one-click download of every section.
Choose the format transient sections are saved in (MP3, WAV or FLAC), or be asked each time.
Fixed the extension's button getting stuck on "✓ Na fila" for something no longer in Cachalot.
VDGET is now Cachalot, with a new icon.
Smarter queue: several downloads at once with per-site limits, automatic retries for temporary failures, and real pause, resume and cancel.
Downloads interrupted by closing SwissTechKnife come back paused and resume where they stopped.
Choose video quality (4K to 360p) or audio format (original, M4A, MP3, Opus, FLAC, WAV) on the page.
Playlists, channels and profiles become one download per item, in their own folder; type a song name to search and download it.
Own extractors for X, Reddit, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Twitch clips and Douyin, including photos and carousels.
Whole galleries and profiles from 250+ image sites, magnet links and .torrent files, and fast multi-connection downloads of direct files.
New Chrome extension: send the page, a link or a detected video to Cachalot with one click, with the site's login cookies.
Settings: subtitles, SponsorBlock, metadata and cover embedding, chapters, .nfo files, file names, per-site folders, rules, speed limit, proxy and per-site cookies.
Follow channels to be told about (or automatically download) new uploads.
Offers a copied link when you come back to the page, optional Ctrl+Alt+D shortcut, and keeps the PC awake while downloading.
YouTube downloads blocked with "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" are retried automatically: with a cookies.txt file, your browsers' cookies, or a fallback player (up to 360p).
yt-dlp now updates itself in the background, at most once a day.
